---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea that fits Cocoon's privacy-first, calm-by-default model
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**The need**
What problem would this solve, and who for (ADHD / autism / anxiety / general)?

**Proposed behavior**
What should it do?

**Privacy check**
Cocoon does not transmit data or run trackers. Does this idea stay local-only?
If not, explain the trade-off.

**Alternatives**
Anything you've tried (other extensions, OS settings) and why it falls short.
